dct_description_sm:
Citywide map illustrates specific zones within zoning categories for residential, office, commercial, downtown core, employment, open space, greenlands, parkway belt, utility, institutional, development, buffer, and airport zones.

DISCLAIMER

Please be advised that Shape_Area and Shape_Length values are based on the WGS84 Web Mercator Datum
